start: Profile tab, a member with some finished workouts

user_sees: Title 'Profile', the member's photo and name
The history chart and the workout feed
must_not: A skeleton that never ends
'1 weeks' for a one-week streak

user_sees: The chart for the new range only
must_not: Bars of the old range shown under the new range's name

steps.action: Scroll down the feed to the end
user_sees: More workouts load; each workout once
must_not: The same workout twice in the feed
The feed stopping at a page size with no way to load more
Another workout opens
A Save button that must be pressed or changes lost on back

steps.action: Change the name, wait a moment, press back
must_not: Profile still showing the old name after coming back
A badge shown as earned that the member has not earned

steps.action: Tap the calendar / month counts to open 'Calendar'
must_not: Rest days counted on a day with a workout

steps.action: Search for a word that matches nothing
must_not: A blank list with no words
A chart range past 3 months opened without the limit check, when the free plan limit is on

user_sees: Each record with its kind badge
must_not: 'No records yet' when the read failed (must say it could not load)
Another exercise opens

user_sees: Subtitle 'Pictures and fonts made by others'
'Read the licence' and 'See the source' links
must_not: A link that opens nothing with no message
An empty name saved

steps.action: Type a name longer than the limit
must_not: The long name saved or cut without a word

user_sees: The link error under its box
must_not: The bad link saved and opened from the Profile

steps.action: Tap the photo, choose camera, refuse the camera
user_sees: 'Camera not allowed' with 'Allow the camera for MettleUp in your phone’s settings, or choose a photo instead.'
must_not: A crash or a blank photo

start: Profile tab, the phone database read fails

user_sees: A load error for 'your profile' with a try again
must_not: 'No workouts yet' shown when the read failed
An endless skeleton

steps.action: Bring the app back to the front
user_sees: The failed part is read again by itself
must_not: The error stuck until the app is restarted

start: Profile tab with the progress hint showing

must_not: The note coming back on the next visit

steps.action: Finish a new workout, return to Profile
user_sees: 'Workouts' count goes up by one; the new workout is first in the feed
must_not: Old counts shown from before the save

steps.action: Delete that workout from its page, return to Profile
user_sees: Count back down; the workout is gone from feed and calendar
must_not: A deleted workout still in the feed, calendar or records

start: Profile tab with a bio and a link

steps.action: Tap 'Share this month as a picture'
user_sees: A picture of the month to share
must_not: The picture showing body weight
The member's phone number on the picture

steps.action: Look at what the gym can see
user_sees: Profile, bio, link and photo stay on this phone (cloud copy only when signed in, own only)
must_not: The gym or another member seeing the bio, link or photo
